subproblem.statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0, (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0, (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for all N, N', k, A : ℝ^N →L ℝ^{N'} and k-covectors β on ℝ^{N'}, and (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for all N, k, v ∈ ℝ^N and (k+1)-covectors β on ℝ^N (exactly the type of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds), and let lpush : ∀ N N' k, (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) satisfy (CHAR) for all N, N', k, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), C^∞ maps Fs_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) with ‖DFs_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for x ∈ spt X and Fs_j → F uniformly on spt X, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and ηs_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) each equal to Fs_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X, we have X(ηs_j) → lpush N N' k F X (ω). Then: (1) lpush N N k (fun x => x) X = X for NC X; (2) lpush F (X − Y) = lpush F X − lpush F Y for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X, Y; (3) lpush F X = lpush G X for Λ-Lipschitz F, G, NC X and F = G on spt X; (4) M(lpush F X) ≤ Λ^k·M(X) and spt lpush F X ⊆ F '' spt X for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X; (5) ∂(lpush N N' (k+1) F X) = lpush N N' k F (∂X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞; (6) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X there are C^∞ Λ-Lipschitz F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) there are η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω on an open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → lpush F X (ω). (These are conjuncts (1)–(6) of the parent, verbatim.)

subproblem.natural_proof:
0. Tools: (A0), (MB), (LOC), (NCD), (NCB) from the sibling toolkit; the support criterion (a) and closedness (b) of the reused support_calculus. Standard approximants: for Λ-Lipschitz F the sibling mollify gives C^∞ Λ-Lipschitz F_j with dist(F_j x, F x) ≤ Λ/(j+1), so F_j → F uniformly on ℝ^N (TendstoUniformly, hence TendstoUniformlyOn every set) and ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ (norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz); for a compact K and a form ω the sibling cutoff gives test forms η_j and open W_j ⊇ K with η_j = F_j^#ω and dη_j = F_j^#(dω) on W_j.
1. (1) Let X ∈ NC_k(ℝ^N) and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N). Apply CHAR with Λ = 1, F = id (LipschitzWith 1 id), Fs_j := id (C^∞, ‖fderiv ℝ id x‖ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id‖ ≤ 1 =: Λ', a constant sequence equal to its limit converges uniformly) and ηs_j := ω (on W = univ, ω(x) = (ω(id x)).compContinuousLinearMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id) = ω(x)). The constant sequence X(ω) therefore converges to lpush N N k id X (ω), so lpush id X (ω) = X(ω) (tendsto_nhds_unique); GeometricCurrentOn.ext gives (1).
2. (2) Let F be Λ-Lipschitz and X, Y ∈ NC_k. By (NCD), X − Y ∈ NC_k and spt(X − Y) ⊆ spt X ∪ spt Y. Fix ω and take standard approximants with K := spt X ∪ spt Y. CHAR for X, Y and X − Y (all supports lie in W_j) gives X(η_j) → lpush F X ω, Y(η_j) → lpush F Y ω and (X − Y)(η_j) = X(η_j) − Y(η_j) → lpush F (X − Y) ω. Uniqueness of limits gives lpush F (X − Y) ω = lpush F X ω − lpush F Y ω = (lpush F X − lpush F Y)(ω); ext.
3. (3) Let F, G be Λ-Lipschitz with F = G on spt X. Take standard approximants (K = spt X). F_j → F uniformly on spt X, and since G = F there also F_j → G uniformly on spt X. CHAR for (F, F_j, η_j) and for (G, F_j, η_j) gives X(η_j) → lpush F X ω and X(η_j) → lpush G X ω; uniqueness of limits and ext give (3).
4. (4) Let F be Λ-Lipschitz and X ∈ NC_k.
4.1. Mass. Let ω and c satisfy |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y; take standard approximants (K = spt X). For x ∈ spt X ⊆ W_j, (L1) gives |η_j(x)| = |(ω(F_j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF_j x)| ≤ ‖DF_j(x)‖^k|ω(F_j x)| ≤ Λ^k c. By (A0), |X(η_j)| ≤ Λ^k c M(X).toReal; by CHAR and passage to the limit, |lpush F X ω| ≤ (Λ^k M(X).toReal)·c. By (MB), M(lpush F X) ≤ ofReal(Λ^k M(X).toReal) = (Λ : ℝ≥0∞)^k·M(X) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_pow, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal since M(X) ≠ ∞).
4.2. Support. E := F '' spt X is compact, hence closed. By support_calculus (a) it suffices to show lpush F X ω = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from E. Then (tsupport ω)ᶜ is an open set containing the compact E, so IsCompact.exists_thickening_subset_open gives r > 0 with thickening r E ⊆ (tsupport ω)ᶜ. Choose j₀ with Λ/(j+1) < r for j ≥ j₀. For j ≥ j₀ and x ∈ spt X, dist(F_j x, F x) < r, so F_j(x) ∈ thickening r E and F_j(x) ∉ tsupport ω. Let V_j := W_j ∩ F_j⁻¹((tsupport ω)ᶜ), open and containing spt X. For x ∈ V_j, ω(F_j x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport), so η_j(x) = 0. By (LOC) with η' = 0, X(η_j) = X(0) = 0 for j ≥ j₀, and CHAR gives lpush F X ω = lim X(η_j) = 0. Hence spt(lpush F X) ⊆ F '' spt X.
5. (5) Let F be Λ-Lipschitz and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1} with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞; then X ∈ NC_{k+1} (boundaryMassOn X univ = M(∂X)) and, by (NCB), ∂X ∈ NC_k with spt ∂X ⊆ spt X. Fix ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and take standard approximants η_j (K = spt X) with η_j = F_j^#ω and dη_j = F_j^#(dω) on W_j. CHAR for X, the form dω and the test forms dη_j = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k η_j gives X(dη_j) → lpush F X (dω) = ∂(lpush F X)(ω) (boundary_apply). CHAR for ∂X, ω and η_j (W_j ⊇ spt X ⊇ spt ∂X) gives ∂X(η_j) → lpush F (∂X) ω. As ∂X(η_j) = X(dη_j), uniqueness of limits gives ∂(lpush F X)(ω) = lpush F (∂X)(ω); ext.
6. (6) Let F be Λ-Lipschitz and X ∈ NC_k. Take Fs := (F_j) from mollify: C^∞, Λ-Lipschitz, TendstoUniformly F_j F (dist ≤ Λ/(j+1) → 0 uniformly). Given ω, let η_j be standard approximants for K = spt X; η_j = F_j^#ω on the open W_j ⊇ spt X, and CHAR gives X(η_j) → lpush F X ω.
proof_key_steps: standard approximants: mollifiers F_j and cut-off pull-backs η_j (mollify, cutoff)
(1) CHAR with the constant sequence id; (2) and (3) CHAR with shared approximants and NC closure (NCD)
(4) mass via (A0)+(L1)+(MB); support via thickening, locality and the support criterion
(5) CHAR for X with dη_j and for ∂X with η_j (NCB, cutoff d-compatibility)
(6) mollifiers with cut-off pull-backs and CHAR

audit.reason: Shared approximants, uniqueness of limits, mass bounds, locality and derivative-compatible cutoffs prove all six exact conclusions. CHAR is an explicit hypothesis, so no dependency on the construction theorem is missing.
